name: Cloud Service Agreement (CSA)
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement governing access to and use of a SaaS/cloud product, covering support, data privacy, payment, term, warranties, liability, and termination.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Mutual NDA) - Standard Terms
description: Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement standard terms protecting confidential information exchanged between two parties evaluating a potential business relationship.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Mutual NDA) - Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the purpose, effective date, term, and governing law/jurisdiction variables that complete the MNDA.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement governing early product access in exchange for structured feedback from a design partner.

name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement defining uptime and support response time commitments, service credits, and remedies for a cloud service.

name: Professional Services Agreement (PSA)
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement governing the provision of professional services under one or more Statements of Work (SOWs).

name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement governing the processing of personal data by a provider (as processor/subprocessor) on behalf of a customer, including GDPR/UK GDPR international transfer mechanisms.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement governing an installed/on-premise software license, including permitted use, updates, open source disclosures, warranties, and liability.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement governing a business partnership involving mutual obligations, trademark licensing, and fee terms.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement governing a time-limited evaluation period during which a customer tests a product before entering a definitive agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement governing the handling of Protected Health Information (PHI) between a covered entity and a business associate under HIPAA.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum supplementing an underlying agreement with terms governing use of AI/ML services, including model training, IP ownership of inputs/outputs, and disclaimers.
